author: Northpoint Orbital NOC
message: The contact dropped two minutes after AOS and never reacquired. Requesting the service credit under §7.2.

author: Ingrid Solberg, Polar Data Systems
message: Our pass dropped during last night's geomagnetic storm and we received nothing. NOAA was reporting strong aurora. We expect full credit for the pass under our SLA.

author: Aether Dynamics mission ops
message: Downlink failed shortly after acquisition while the storm was ongoing. Only a few frames came through. Please apply the Schedule B credit.

author: Kestrel Earth Imaging
message: We were told about the antenna work the afternoon before. Nearly half of our contact was lost. We did not agree to that window.

author: Nexus Corp ground segment
message: Files from this pass are corrupted end to end, so effectively nothing usable arrived. We are requesting a full refund of the pass fee.

author: Helix Orbital
message: First claim on our new account: about half the contact had no downlink. Please advise on the credit.

author: SkyNet Communications
message: Contact degraded badly during the solar storm. Requesting credit for the lost minutes.

author: Orbital Sciences Inc
message: We lost the end of the pass and with it the whole science dump. Requesting a full refund of the pass fee.
